dialogue.text: There are eight parts of speech, verb, noun, adjective, adverb, pronoun, interjection, and conjunction, preposition.
dialogue.zh: 有八種詞性，動詞、名詞、形容詞、副詞、代詞、感嘆詞、連接詞和介詞。
dialogue.ja: 品詞は全部で8つあります。動詞、名詞、形容詞、副詞、代名詞、感嘆詞、接続詞、そして前置詞です。
dialogue.local: There are eight parts of speech, verb, noun, adjective, adverb, pronoun, interjection, and conjunction, preposition.
dialogue.en: There are eight parts of speech, verb, noun, adjective, adverb, pronoun, interjection, and conjunction, preposition.

dialogue.text: These allow us to structure a grammatically correct sentence as each has a different function within a sentence.
dialogue.zh: 這些詞性讓我們能夠構造語法正確的句子，因為它們在句子中各有不同的功能。
dialogue.ja: これらはそれぞれ異なる役割を持ち、文法的に正しい文を作ることができます。
dialogue.local: These allow us to structure a grammatically correct sentence as each has a different function within a sentence.
dialogue.en: These allow us to structure a grammatically correct sentence as each has a different function within a sentence.

dialogue.text: Verb, adverb describes an action or experience. For example, run, walk, push, eat.
dialogue.zh: 動詞和副詞描述一個動作或經驗。例如：跑、走、推、吃。
dialogue.ja: 動詞や副詞は動作や経験を表します。例えば、走る、歩く、押す、食べるなどです。
dialogue.local: Verb, adverb describes an action or experience. For example, run, walk, push, eat.
dialogue.en: Verb, adverb describes an action or experience. For example, run, walk, push, eat.

dialogue.text: Sophie ran to school because she was late. The verb in this sentence is ran.
dialogue.zh: 蘇菲因為遲到了，所以跑去學校。這句話中的動詞是 ran。
dialogue.ja: ソフィーは遅刻したので学校へ走って行きました。この文の動詞は「ran」です。
dialogue.local: Sophie ran to school because she was late. The verb in this sentence is ran.
dialogue.en: Sophie ran to school because she was late. The verb in this sentence is ran.

dialogue.text: John loves to bake cookies. The verb in this sentence is bake.
dialogue.zh: 約翰喜歡烤餅乾。這句話中的動詞是 bake。
dialogue.ja: ジョンはクッキーを焼くのが好きです。この文の動詞は「bake」です。
dialogue.local: John loves to bake cookies. The verb in this sentence is bake.
dialogue.en: John loves to bake cookies. The verb in this sentence is bake.

dialogue.text: Now, a noun names a person, place, thing, or idea. For example, house, teacher, cup, shop.
dialogue.zh: 現在，名詞用來命名人、地點、物品或想法。例如：房子、老師、杯子、商店。
dialogue.ja: 次に、名詞は人、場所、物、または考えを表します。例えば、家、先生、カップ、店などです。
dialogue.local: Now, a noun names a person, place, thing, or idea. For example, house, teacher, cup, shop.
dialogue.en: Now, a noun names a person, place, thing, or idea. For example, house, teacher, cup, shop.

dialogue.text: My teacher is a very nice person. The noun in this sentence is teacher.
dialogue.zh: 我的老師是一個非常好的人。這句話中的名詞是 teacher。
dialogue.ja: 私の先生はとても優しい人です。この文の名詞は「teacher」です。
dialogue.local: My teacher is a very nice person. The noun in this sentence is teacher.
dialogue.en: My teacher is a very nice person. The noun in this sentence is teacher.

dialogue.text: Amy is going to go on holiday to China. There are two nouns in this sentence.
dialogue.zh: 艾米打算去中國度假。這句話中有兩個名詞。
dialogue.ja: エイミーは中国へ休暇に行く予定です。この文には名詞が2つあります。
dialogue.local: Amy is going to go on holiday to China. There are two nouns in this sentence.
dialogue.en: Amy is going to go on holiday to China. There are two nouns in this sentence.

dialogue.text: The first noun is Amy because it's a person's name. The second noun is China because it is the name of a place.
dialogue.zh: 第一個名詞是 Amy，因為它是人的名字。第二個名詞是 China，因為它是地名。
dialogue.ja: 最初の名詞は「Amy」で、人の名前だからです。2つ目の名詞は「China」で、場所の名前だからです。
dialogue.local: The first noun is Amy because it's a person's name. The second noun is China because it is the name of a place.
dialogue.en: The first noun is Amy because it's a person's name. The second noun is China because it is the name of a place.

dialogue.text: Adjective. An adjective describes a noun or a pronoun. For example, short, beautiful, red, old.
dialogue.zh: 形容詞。形容詞用來描述名詞或代詞。例如：矮的、美麗的、紅色的、老的。
dialogue.ja: 形容詞は名詞や代名詞を説明します。例えば、短い、美しい、赤い、古いなどです。
dialogue.local: Adjective. An adjective describes a noun or a pronoun. For example, short, beautiful, red, old.
dialogue.en: Adjective. An adjective describes a noun or a pronoun. For example, short, beautiful, red, old.

dialogue.text: Fatima has a huge house with six bedrooms. The adjective in this sentence is huge because they're describing Fatima's house.
dialogue.zh: 法蒂瑪有一棟有六間臥室的巨大房子。這句話中的形容詞是 huge，因為它描述法蒂瑪的房子。
dialogue.ja: ファティマは6つの寝室がある大きな家を持っています。この文の形容詞は「huge」で、ファティマの家を説明しています。
dialogue.local: Fatima has a huge house with six bedrooms. The adjective in this sentence is huge because they're describing Fatima's house.
dialogue.en: Fatima has a huge house with six bedrooms. The adjective in this sentence is huge because they're describing Fatima's house.

dialogue.text: Adverb. An adverb describes a verb, an adjective, or an adverb. The adverb tells us how often, how, where, or when.
dialogue.zh: 副詞。副詞用來描述動詞、形容詞或副詞。副詞告訴我們頻率、方式、地點或時間。
dialogue.ja: 副詞は動詞、形容詞、または他の副詞を説明します。副詞はどのくらいの頻度で、どのように、どこで、いつを教えてくれます。
dialogue.local: Adverb. An adverb describes a verb, an adjective, or an adverb. The adverb tells us how often, how, where, or when.
dialogue.en: Adverb. An adverb describes a verb, an adjective, or an adverb. The adverb tells us how often, how, where, or when.

dialogue.text: For example, slowly, yesterday, always.
dialogue.zh: 例如：慢慢地、昨天、總是。
dialogue.ja: 例えば、ゆっくり、昨日、いつもなどです。
dialogue.local: For example, slowly, yesterday, always.
dialogue.en: For example, slowly, yesterday, always.

dialogue.text: Sophie is always late for school. The adverb in this sentence is always.
dialogue.zh: 蘇菲上學總是遲到。這句話中的副詞是 always。
dialogue.ja: ソフィーはいつも学校に遅刻します。この文の副詞は「always」です。
dialogue.local: Sophie is always late for school. The adverb in this sentence is always.
dialogue.en: Sophie is always late for school. The adverb in this sentence is always.

dialogue.text: It is also important to note that late is an adverb and an adjective.
dialogue.zh: 同時要注意，late 既是副詞也是形容詞。
dialogue.ja: また、「late」は副詞でもあり形容詞でもあることに注意してください。
dialogue.local: It is also important to note that late is an adverb and an adjective.
dialogue.en: It is also important to note that late is an adverb and an adjective.

dialogue.text: Last night, I slept really well. The adverb in this sentence is last night.
dialogue.zh: 昨晚我睡得很好。這句話中的副詞是 last night。
dialogue.ja: 昨夜、私はとてもよく眠りました。この文の副詞は「last night」です。
dialogue.local: Last night, I slept really well. The adverb in this sentence is last night.
dialogue.en: Last night, I slept really well. The adverb in this sentence is last night.

dialogue.text: Pronoun. A pronoun is used to replace the name of a person, place, thing, or idea in a sentence.
dialogue.zh: 代詞。代詞用來替代句子中人的名字、地點、物品或想法。
dialogue.ja: 代名詞は文中の人、場所、物、または考えの名前を置き換えるために使われます。
dialogue.local: Pronoun. A pronoun is used to replace the name of a person, place, thing, or idea in a sentence.
dialogue.en: Pronoun. A pronoun is used to replace the name of a person, place, thing, or idea in a sentence.

dialogue.text: For example, I, she, our, they, it.
dialogue.zh: 例如：我、她、我們的、他們、它。
dialogue.ja: 例えば、私、彼女、私たちの、彼ら、それなどです。
dialogue.local: For example, I, she, our, they, it.
dialogue.en: For example, I, she, our, they, it.

dialogue.text: Becky is a very nice friend. She always helps me with my homework. The pronoun in this sentence is she.
dialogue.zh: 貝琪是個非常好的朋友。她總是幫我做作業。這句話中的代詞是 she。
dialogue.ja: ベッキーはとても良い友達です。彼女はいつも私の宿題を手伝ってくれます。この文の代名詞は「she」です。
dialogue.local: Becky is a very nice friend. She always helps me with my homework. The pronoun in this sentence is she.
dialogue.en: Becky is a very nice friend. She always helps me with my homework. The pronoun in this sentence is she.

dialogue.text: You can visit the shopping center at one o'clock. The pronoun in this sentence is you.
dialogue.zh: 你可以在一點鐘去購物中心。這句話中的代詞是 you。
dialogue.ja: あなたは1時にショッピングセンターを訪れることができます。この文の代名詞は「you」です。
dialogue.local: You can visit the shopping center at one o'clock. The pronoun in this sentence is you.
dialogue.en: You can visit the shopping center at one o'clock. The pronoun in this sentence is you.

dialogue.text: Interjection. An interjection is used to express strong emotion and is often followed by an exclamation mark.
dialogue.zh: 感嘆詞。感嘆詞用來表達強烈的情感，通常後面會接驚嘆號。
dialogue.ja: 感嘆詞は強い感情を表すために使われ、しばしば感嘆符が続きます。
dialogue.local: Interjection. An interjection is used to express strong emotion and is often followed by an exclamation mark.
dialogue.en: Interjection. An interjection is used to express strong emotion and is often followed by an exclamation mark.

dialogue.text: For example, wow, or oh.
dialogue.zh: 例如：哇，或喔。
dialogue.ja: 例えば、「わあ」や「おお」などです。
dialogue.local: For example, wow, or oh.
dialogue.en: For example, wow, or oh.

dialogue.text: Wow, the view is amazing. The interjection in this sentence is wow.
dialogue.zh: 哇，這景色真棒。這句話中的感嘆詞是 wow。
dialogue.ja: わあ、その景色は素晴らしいです。この文の感嘆詞は「wow」です。
dialogue.local: Wow, the view is amazing. The interjection in this sentence is wow.
dialogue.en: Wow, the view is amazing. The interjection in this sentence is wow.

dialogue.text: Hey, I haven't seen you in a long time. The interjection in this sentence is hey.
dialogue.zh: 嘿，好久不見你了。這句話中的感嘆詞是 hey。
dialogue.ja: やあ、久しぶりだね。この文の感嘆詞は「hey」です。
dialogue.local: Hey, I haven't seen you in a long time. The interjection in this sentence is hey.
dialogue.en: Hey, I haven't seen you in a long time. The interjection in this sentence is hey.

dialogue.text: Conjunction. Conjunction is used to connect words, phrases, or clauses in a sentence.
dialogue.zh: 連接詞。連接詞用來連接句子中的詞、片語或子句。
dialogue.ja: 接続詞は文中の単語、句、または節をつなぐために使われます。
dialogue.local: Conjunction. Conjunction is used to connect words, phrases, or clauses in a sentence.
dialogue.en: Conjunction. Conjunction is used to connect words, phrases, or clauses in a sentence.

dialogue.text: For example, and, but, although, or.
dialogue.zh: 例如：和、但是、雖然、或者。
dialogue.ja: 例えば、「and（そして）」、「but（しかし）」、「although（〜だけれども）」、「or（または）」などです。
dialogue.local: For example, and, but, although, or.
dialogue.en: For example, and, but, although, or.

dialogue.text: I like to watch the television and eat popcorn. The conjunction in this sentence is and.
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡看電視和吃爆米花。這句話中的連接詞是 and。
dialogue.ja: 私はテレビを見てポップコーンを食べるのが好きです。この文の接続詞は「and」です。
dialogue.local: I like to watch the television and eat popcorn. The conjunction in this sentence is and.
dialogue.en: I like to watch the television and eat popcorn. The conjunction in this sentence is and.

dialogue.text: My friend is very loud, whereas I am very quiet. The conjunction in this sentence is whereas.
dialogue.zh: 我的朋友很吵，而我很安靜。這句話中的連接詞是 whereas。
dialogue.ja: 私の友達はとてもうるさいですが、私はとても静かです。この文の接続詞は「whereas」です。
dialogue.local: My friend is very loud, whereas I am very quiet. The conjunction in this sentence is whereas.
dialogue.en: My friend is very loud, whereas I am very quiet. The conjunction in this sentence is whereas.

dialogue.text: Preposition. Prepositions describe the place, time, or direction. It is used before a noun or pronoun.
dialogue.zh: 介詞。介詞描述地點、時間或方向，通常用在名詞或代詞前面。
dialogue.ja: 前置詞は場所、時間、方向を表し、名詞や代名詞の前に使われます。
dialogue.local: Preposition. Prepositions describe the place, time, or direction. It is used before a noun or pronoun.
dialogue.en: Preposition. Prepositions describe the place, time, or direction. It is used before a noun or pronoun.

dialogue.text: For example, under, above, in, during.
dialogue.zh: 例如：在…下面、在…上面、在…裡面、在…期間。
dialogue.ja: 例えば、「under（下に）」、「above（上に）」、「in（中に）」、「during（〜の間に）」などです。
dialogue.local: For example, under, above, in, during.
dialogue.en: For example, under, above, in, during.

dialogue.text: The cat jumped over the box. The preposition in this sentence is over.
dialogue.zh: 貓跳過盒子。這句話中的介詞是 over。
dialogue.ja: 猫が箱の上を飛び越えました。この文の前置詞は「over」です。
dialogue.local: The cat jumped over the box. The preposition in this sentence is over.
dialogue.en: The cat jumped over the box. The preposition in this sentence is over.

dialogue.text: Get into the car quickly before we are late to school. The preposition in this sentence is into.
dialogue.zh: 快點進車裡，免得我們上學遲到。這句話中的介詞是 into。
dialogue.ja: 遅刻しないように急いで車に乗ってください。この文の前置詞は「into」です。
dialogue.local: Get into the car quickly before we are late to school. The preposition in this sentence is into.
dialogue.en: Get into the car quickly before we are late to school. The preposition in this sentence is into.

dialogue.text: Now it's your turn. Can you write a paragraph which includes all the eight parts of speech? Write it in the comments below and I look forward to reading them.
dialogue.zh: 現在輪到你了。你能寫一段包含所有八種詞性的段落嗎？請在下方留言，我期待閱讀你的作品。
dialogue.ja: さあ、あなたの番です。8つの品詞すべてを含む段落を書けますか？下のコメント欄に書いてください。読むのを楽しみにしています。
dialogue.local: Now it's your turn. Can you write a paragraph which includes all the eight parts of speech? Write it in the comments below and I look forward to reading them.
dialogue.en: Now it's your turn. Can you write a paragraph which includes all the eight parts of speech? Write it in the comments below and I look forward to reading them.
